description: Synthetic compliance fixtures for retrieval regression tests; not legal advice.

documents.text: The CBAM scope covers cement, iron and steel, aluminium, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen. Product classification depends on the applicable CN code.
The CBAM transitional period runs from 1 October 2023 through 31 December 2025. The definitive period starts on 1 January 2026.
During the transitional period, reporting declarants submit a CBAM report for each quarter. The report includes quantities of imported goods and their embedded direct and indirect emissions.
A basic greenhouse gas calculation multiplies activity data by the matching emission factor. Results are normalized and reported as kilograms or tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent, written CO2e.

Auditable evidence records preserve the source identifier, reporting period, responsible organization, calculation version and upload timestamp. Reviewers must be able to trace a reported value to its evidence.
Primary supplier data should identify the facility, production period, measurement unit and verification status. Missing fields are recorded as data quality gaps instead of being invented.
Textile product traceability links a finished garment to material composition, manufacturing facility, supplier and production batch. It is separate from CBAM product coverage.
Energy evidence may include utility invoices, meter readings and renewable energy certificates. Every record needs a date range and an organization owner.
